environment.description: Pipeline trigger service deployed on ECS Fargate with origin access restricted through CloudFront distribution (d1234abcdef.cloudfront.net). Origin is configured with custom header X-Origin-Verify whose value is a rotating 256-bit secret managed by Secrets Manager automatic rotation (every 4 hours). ALB listener rule requires X-Origin-Verify header match before forwarding to target group (fixed-response 403 otherwise). CloudFront distribution has a Behavior configured with Restrict Viewer Access = Yes using Trusted Key Group (key group kg-0a1b2c3d4e) requiring RSA-2048 signed URLs with canned policy. CloudFront cache behavior path pattern /api/* has Viewer Protocol Policy HTTPS-only and the signed URL policy constrains source IP to the requester's /32 CIDR embedded at signing time. Signing keys are issued only to the internal CI orchestrator service (Jenkins controller at 10.0.1.50) via IAM role assumption with condition aws:SourceIp matching the VPC CIDR. No public CloudFront signing key distribution endpoint exists. Additionally, the ALB security group restricts inbound to CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing) only.
